commons.title: Faces of Chutia, Kachari and Ahom men, 1900.jpg
commons.description: This photo from the book "The tribes of the Brahmaputra Valley"(JASB) shows three men belonging to the Chutia, Ahom and Kachari ethnicities.
commons.editorial_reason: The caption identifies Chutia, Kachari, and Ahom men, but the image is only a set of head-and-shoulders portraits with no visible traditional dress, adornment, craft, performance, architecture, or cultural objects.
